scope: Synthetic-only same-volume Windows checkpoint study; no transport integration or source requests
preservation: All prior Git tracked byte hashes and complete old operations history; all source/mouse/scientific/holdout locks remain unchanged

diagnostics.metadata: Synthetic handles/ACL/attributes/volume/process context; no protected experimental file reads
diagnostics.cause_policy: Do not infer an endpoint-security or exact historical handle cause from an intermittent error; demonstrably effective scoped fix can satisfy gate

candidate: One fully verified immutable envelope file instead of multi-file protected-directory rename; native same-volume MoveFileExW, no copy/delete fallback; write+flush+close+verify before publish; custody DACL retained

local_commit_budget.policy: Verify protected ACL/attributes/volume each time; never change permissions to repair denial; exhausted attempts stop; injected persistent denial remains expected STOP,not successful commit

writers: Destination-specific native byte-range writer lock; shared-delete readers may observe complete old or complete new envelope; conflicting writers fail closed; immutable identity/hash reuse,explicit expected-previous-digest required for replacements
environment_limit: Two native process contexts on this same Windows machine/volume,not two independently tested OS installations
fixtures: Fixed deterministic synthetic bytes; same-volume protected staging under this study only; all attempts/outcomes retained; no favorable seed/configuration selection
mandatory_injections: interrupt after native publish before receipt
security: Actual zero-capability native analysis role must be denied committed synthetic checkpoint/key reads,DACL regrant,network and custodian memory; no host-admin defense claim; no holdout cryptography changes
gate: PASS only all200 noninjected calls complete with zero unexpected terminal failures,all separate injections safely stop/recover as registered,all old tests pass,security passes and code/evidence are freshly bound; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE/CHECKPOINT_REPAIR_UNVERIFIED
stop: Always stop after synthetic validation; even PASS does not permit actual checkpoint/session/source retry,M3-M7 or final release
reproduction: One-command synthetic native test replay and separate saved-only evidence verification; never invoke old retrieval or private experimental QC
